references.text: The parallel verse about the youngest daughter's son Ben-Ammi, the ancestor of the Ammonites, born under the same circumstances as Moab
God commands Israel not to attack Moab because He has given Ar to Lot's descendants as a possession - Moab being Lot's son (Gen 19:37)
Moabites shall not enter the assembly of the Lord, a law that relates directly to Moab's origin
Ruth was Moabitess, and the story shows Moab's descendants and their relationship with Israel
Moab is mentioned among the nations conspiring against Israel, a nation descended from Lot (Gen 19:37)
Prophecy against Moab - judgment over the nation that descends from Lot's eldest daughter
